question: If 85% of a number is added to 75, then the result is the number itself. The number is :

solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 अर्थात 500 है।

संख्या का 15% = 75

100% \(\rightarrow\) \(75\over15\) \(\times\) 100 = 500.

question:
If (x +20)% of 250 is 25% more than x% of 220, then 10% of (x+50) is what percent less than 15% of x?

(CGL MAINS 2019)
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 16\(\frac{2}{3}\).

(x + 20)% of 250 = \(\frac{5}{4}\) (x% of 220)

\(\frac{x\ +\ 20}{100}\) \(\times\) 250 \(\times\) 4 = 5 \(\times\) \(\frac{x}{100}\) \(\times\) 220

1000x + 20000 = 1100x 

100x = 20000 

x = 200 

10% of (x + 50) = \(\frac{1}{10}\) \(\times\) 250 = 25 

15% of x = \(\frac{15}{100}\) \(\times\) 200 = 30

Loss = 30 - 25 = 5 

Loss% = \(\frac{5}{30}\) × 100 = 16\(\frac{2}{3}\)%.
question_hi:
यदि 250 का (x +20)%, 220 के x% से 25% अधिक है, तो (x+50) का 10%, x के 15% से कितने प्रतिशत कम है?

(CGL MAINS 2019)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात 16\(\frac{2}{3}\) है।

250 का (x + 20)% = \(\frac{5}{4}\) (220 का x%)

\(\frac{x\ +\ 20}{100}\) \(\times\) 250 \(\times\) 4 = 5 \(\times\) \(\frac{x}{100}\) \(\times\) 220

1000x + 20000 = 1100x 

100x = 20000 

x = 200 

(x + 50) का 10% = \(\frac{1}{10}\) \(\times\) 250 = 25 

x का 15% = \(\frac{15}{100}\) \(\times\) 200 = 30

हानि = 30 - 25 = 5 

हानि % =\(\frac{5}{30}\) × 100 = 16\(\frac{2}{3}\)%.

question: A number which, when increased by 16% becomes 1914. The number is:
solution:
Let the number be x.

According to the question:

x + 16% of x = 1914

x + (16/100)x = 1914

x(116/100) = 1914

x = 1914 × 100/116

x = 1650

प्रश्न के अनुसार:

x + x का 16% = 1914

x + (16/100)x = 1914

x(116/100) = 1914

x = 1914 × 100/116

x = 1650

question:
If x% of y is 150 and y% of z is 300, then the relation between x and z is:

(CHSL 2018 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. z = 2x.

x/100 × y = 150

xy = 15000 …(1)

y% of z = 300

y/100 × z = 300

yz = 30000 …(2)

Divide (2) by (1):

(yz) / (xy) = 30000 / 15000

z / x = 2

z = 2x

(2) को (1) से भाग देने पर:

z / x = 2

z = 2x

question:
If a% of 240 is c and c% of a is 117.6, then the value of a + c is:

(CHSL 2019 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. 238.

\(\frac{240a}{100}\) = c  ……………(i)

\(\frac{ca}{100}\)  = 117.6 \( \Longrightarrow\) ca = 11760 ………...(ii) 

Put the value of 'c' equation (ii) 

\(\frac{240a^2}{100}\) = 11760 

a = 70 

c = \(\frac{240\ \times\ 70}{100}\) = 168 

\(\Longrightarrow\) a + c = 70 + 168 = 238
question_hi:

समीकरण (ii) में 'c' का मान रखें 

\(\frac{240a^2}{100}\) = 11760 

a = 70 

c = \(\frac{240\ \times\ 70}{100}\) = 168 

\(\Longrightarrow\) a + c = 70 + 168 = 238

question:
If \(\left(2^2+\ 4\right)^2\) \(\times\) (3 – 5 ) + 20% of 400 + x% of 30 = 30% of 30, find the value of x.

(CHSL 2023 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 190.

\(\left(2^2+\ 4\right)^2\) \(\times\)  (3 – 5) + 20% of 400 + x% of 30 = 30% of 30

\(\Rightarrow\) 64(- 2) + 80 + \(\frac{x}{100} \) \(\times\) 30 = 9

\(\Rightarrow\) - 48 + \(\frac{3x}{10}\) = 9 

\(\Rightarrow\) \(\frac{3x}{10}\) = 9 + 48 = 57

\(\Rightarrow\) 3x = 570 

x = 190

question:

\(\frac{A}{5}\) : \(\frac{B}{50}\) :\(\frac{C}{2000}\)

2000 unit = 5500

1 unit 2.75

A = 13.75

B = 137.5

C = 5500

\(\Longrightarrow\) 40% of A + 20% of B

= 40% of 13.75 + 20% of 137.5

संख्या A का 11/5 भाग संख्या B का 22% है। संख्या B तीसरी संख्या C के 2.5% के बराबर है। यदि संख्या C का मान 5500 है, तो A के 40% और B के 20% का योग क्या है?

(MTS 2020 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात 33 है।

\(\frac{11}{5}\) A = \(\frac{11}{50}\) B 

A : B = 1 : 10 

B = 2.5% of C 

B = \(\frac{25}{1000}\) C \(\Longrightarrow\) \(\frac{B}{25}\) : \(\frac{C}{1000}\)

\(\frac{A}{5}\) : \(\frac{B}{50}\) : \(\frac{C}{2000}\)

2000 इकाई = 5500 

1 इकाई 2.75 

A = 13.75 

B = 137.5 

C = 5500 

\(\Longrightarrow\) A का 40% + B का 20%

= 13.75 का 40% + 137.5 का 20%

5.5 + 27.5 = 33

question:

solution:

Apply componendo & dividendo:-

\(\Rightarrow\) x = \(\frac{100}{13} \)

x% of 91 \(\Rightarrow\) \(\frac{100}{1300}\) \(\times\) 91 \(\Rightarrow\) 7

question:
If x exceeds 25% of itself by 72, and y exceeds 40% of itself by 60, then y exceeds x by: (correct to one decimal place)

(SP Phase-9)
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 4.2%.

x = 96

5y - 2y = 300 

y = 100 

y exceeds x by = \(\frac{4}{96}\) × 100 = 4.2%

question:
The ratio of (45% of 80% of A) to (30% of 40% of B) is 15 : 4. If the average of A and B is 67.5, what is the value of A - B?

(MTS 2021)
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. 15.

(45% of 80% of A)/(30% of 40% of B)= \(\frac{15}{4} \)

\(\frac{3\times2\times A\ }{2\times B}\) = \(\frac{15}{4}\)

\(\left.\frac{A}{B}=\frac{5}{4}\right]\) difference = 1

A + B = 5 + 4 = 9 unit 

9 unit → 67.5 × 2 = 135 

1 unit → 135/9 = 15 

\(\therefore\)  A – B = 1 unit = 15

(MTS 2021)
solution_hi:

A + B = 5 + 4 = 9 इकाई

9 इकाई → 67.5 × 2 = 135 

1 इकाई → 135/9 = 15 

\(\therefore\)  A – B = 1 इकाई = 15

question:
The income of A is 20% less than the income of B and the income of C is 70% of the sum of incomes of A and B. The income of D is 25% more than the income of C. If the difference between the incomes of B and D is ₹23000. then what is the income (in ₹) of A?

1 unit = 400

A's salary = 80 units = ₹32000

एक व्यक्ति तीन वस्तुएं P, Q और R ₹3330 में खरीदता है। यदि P की कीमत R से 25% अधिक है और R की कीमत Q से 20% अधिक है, तो P की कीमत क्या है?

solution_hi:

P     Q    R
5x3         4x3

question:

solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. 7308.

87        100

= 28 × 3 × 87 = 7308

question:

question:

      208    68      140

Required % = \(\frac{68}{208}\) × 100% = 32.7%

(CGL 2022 Pre)
solution_hi:

वेतन        खर्च           बचत
100         60            40    
  ↓              ↓             ↓

100 × \(\frac{13}{10}\) × \(\frac{16}{10}\)     40 × \(\frac{350}{100}\)

      208    68      140

अभीष्ट % = \(\frac{68}{208}\) × 100% = 32.7%
